Meridian Digital
Product Pricing Contact Blog

Project Management That Works

Plan, track, and deliver work with your team in one place. Meridian brings clarity to complex projects so your team can focus on what matters.

Start Free Trial

No credit card required. Free for 14 days.

Trusted by 500+ teams including engineering, marketing, and operations departments at companies of every size.

Everything Your Team Needs

Visual Project Planning

Map out your entire project with Gantt charts, Kanban boards, and timeline views. Drag and drop tasks to adjust plans in real time. See the big picture without losing sight of the details.

Smart Task Management

Create tasks with custom fields, dependencies, and priority levels. Set due dates, assign owners, and track progress with automated status updates. Never let a task slip through the cracks.

Team Collaboration

Comment on tasks, share files, and tag teammates directly within your projects. Real-time notifications keep everyone aligned without the noise of endless email chains.

Reporting and Insights

Track velocity, workload balance, and project health with customizable dashboards. Generate reports for stakeholders in one click. Data-driven decisions replace gut feelings.

Built for the Way You Work

Meridian adapts to your workflow, not the other way around. Whether your team follows Agile sprints, Waterfall milestones, or a hybrid approach, our platform supports your methodology with flexible templates and configurable workflows.

  • Integrations: Connect with Slack, GitHub, Jira, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and 40+ other tools your team already uses.
  • Automation: Eliminate repetitive work with rule-based triggers. Automatically assign tasks, update statuses, and send notifications when conditions are met.
  • Security: Enterprise-grade security with SOC 2 Type II compliance, SAML SSO, and granular role-based permissions.
  • Mobile: Full-featured iOS and Android apps so your team stays connected on the go.

What Our Customers Say

"Meridian transformed how our engineering team plans sprints. We cut our planning meetings in half and everyone has clear visibility into what is being worked on. It is the most intuitive PM tool we have used."

— Rachel Torres, VP of Engineering at CloudFirst
"We evaluated six project management platforms before choosing Meridian. The combination of powerful features and a clean interface made the decision easy. Our team was fully onboarded within a week."

— David Kim, Operations Director at DataPeak

Ready to Get Started?

Join 500+ teams that use Meridian to ship faster and stay aligned.

Start Your Free Trial

14-day free trial. No credit card required.

observations.pageSummary: This is a marketing landing page for Meridian Digital’s project management product, Meridian. It presents collaboration, planning, task management, reporting, integrations, automation, security, and mobile app features for teams considering project management software. The page primarily encourages visitors to start a free 14-day trial.
